extraction.Name: Jeffrey Miller
extraction.Refused/Protested: Yes, I told Mr. Britton that I did not want it and he answered that I might as well take it as it had been issued and would be put on record that the taxes would accrue just the same.
extraction.Recorded patent: It was in 1918 that Mr. Britton the farmer brought it to me in Herrick.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I first mortgaged it and then sold it
extraction.Buyer: Iris Baldwin, Herrick South Dakota, for $3700.00 as follows: the mortgage, tax and interest was $3000 which was held out and I received $700 at the time of sale
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: the mortgage, tax and interest was $3000 which was held out
extraction.NOTES: Allottee stated: 'I have always held that the Government erred in issuing this patent before the end of the 25 years that it was agreed that it should be held. I think it was an injustice to me to have the patent issued. I did the best I could with the money I got from the land.' Has four children. Document page references: 7, 266, 1. Notary: Jas. W. Gross, commission expires 4-28-32.
